audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text says "his Warrior's Trickery (P) armor stacking". That is wrong twice: there is no ability called Warrior's Trickery, and the armor stacking is not his passive slot's name.
audit.why: Wukong's W is Warrior Trickster (invisibility, a dash, and a clone) — it has nothing to do with armor. The stacking armor is Stone Skin (P): 'Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.' A player reading the current line will hunt for armor stacks on the wrong ability and will not respect the clone.
audit.corrected: Stone Skin (P) is the stacking armor; Warrior Trickster (W) is the invisibility-plus-clone dash on a 22s rank-1 cooldown.
sources: champ-data/_kits/monkeyking.json (Stone Skin P, Warrior Trickster W CD 22/21/20/19/18)

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer notices that Wukong's signature defensive stat is irrelevant against Zac's main damage source.
audit.why: Stone Skin (P) stacks ARMOR the longer a fight runs, and Crushing Blow (Q) shreds Zac's armor. But Unstable Matter (W) deals a percentage of max health as MAGIC damage on a flat 5s cooldown, so none of his armor stacking reduces it. That reframes the extended fight: Zac should not try to out-armor him, he should keep W ticking and build MR/HP instead.
audit.corrected: Stone Skin is armor, your W is percent-max-HP magic — his defensive stacking does nothing against your primary damage.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zac.json (Unstable Matter: percentHealth, magic damage, 5s CD)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nimbus Strike (E) is described as 'a free gap-close' without saying what it can be cast on.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy'. That includes minions, so at 650 range the wave itself is his gap-closer — standing behind your own minions does not keep him off you the way it would against a champion-only dash. That is the practical difference between spacing that works and spacing that does not.
audit.corrected: Nimbus Strike dashes to any targeted enemy including minions, so the wave is his gap-closer, not your shield. 10s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers appear anywhere in this matchup despite the whole entry being organised around cooldown windows.
audit.why: Crushing Blow 8s, Nimbus Strike 10s, Warrior Trickster 22s, Cyclone 130/110/90s. Cyclone in particular is a 130-second rank-1 cooldown with only 315 range — it is a genuine swing point but he has to already be on top of Zac to use it, which the current "6 is his window not yours" framing overstates.
audit.corrected: Cyclone is 130s at rank 1 and only 315 range; Warrior Trickster is 22s, so the clone is not always available.

edits.before: Wukong's Nimbus Strike (E) dash plus Crushing Blow (Q) armor-shred combo out-trades your blob at every pre-6 window; his Warrior's Trickery (P) armor stacking makes him tankier than you the moment he has two points in Q.
edits.after: Wukong's Nimbus Strike (E) dash plus Crushing Blow (Q) armor-shred out-trades your blob at every pre-6 window, and Stone Skin (P) stacks armor the longer you fight — but that armor does nothing against your magic-damage W.

edits.after: After his first item his tower-dive with a jungler is scary, but Cell Division plus a tank item lets you survive it and CC-chain him — and his Q armor shred is wasted on a Zac who wins with percent-HP magic damage.

edits.after: Wukong out-stats you at 1-2: Crushing Blow (Q) shreds your armor on an 8s cooldown and Nimbus Strike (E) dashes to any target — minions included — so the wave is his gap-closer. Just farm rather than contesting short trades where Stone Skin (P) wins the sustained exchange.

edits.after: Level 4-5 is your one soft window — E-R engage is online and you can punish him if his Q or E is down — but at 6 Cyclone (R) flips it: 130s at rank 1 but only 315 range, so it knocks you up and interrupts your Slingshot charge only if he is already on top of you.

notes: Confirmed real error fixed: "Warrior's Trickery (P)" was wrong in both name and slot — W is Warrior Trickster, the armor stacking is Stone Skin (P). The other two packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: "Let's Bounce" (file writes "Let's Bounce!", detector strips the '!') and "Use Cell Division" (the ability name is correct, 'Use' is just the preceding verb). LEFT ALONE AS UNVERIFIED: spikes[1].text claims "his knock-up cancels your ult mid-flight". The League Wiki's interrupt table for Let's Bounce! appears to list only Death, which would make that claim wrong — but I could not confirm it well enough to rewrite, so I did not touch the sentence. This same claim recurs in the Yasuo and Yone entries and is worth one deliberate wiki check, because it changes whether Zac players are told to ult at all. The Elastic Slingshot CHARGE being interruptible by knock-up is separately supported (wiki lists Knockdown: Interrupted for E), so the `mid` text's version of the claim is safe and I kept it.
